description: The app classes the built backend can start with app_start: the deployed dev apps (source "dev") and the framework's own (its z2ui5_cl_pop_* popups, the startup app; source "framework"), read from the transpiled output - an app deployed after the last build_backend is not in it yet. Optional `filter`: a substring of the class name. Needs a build_backend first; starts nothing.

filter.description: substring of the class name, case-insensitive (e.g. "smp_app_00")

name: app_list
